name: Caption News
vibe: Sound-off social news: huge ivory captions slammed in chunk by chunk over graded real footage, one keyword per line on a honey-yellow block, a small news package (bug, source tag, lower third) and nothing else.

reference.creator: lemo-opuscar · styles/caption-news ("The Bee Ledger" demo; code/docs MIT, demo CC BY 4.0)
reference.what: caption card (heavy sans, ivory #F7F5EF, soft dark shadow, no stroke, 2–3 chunks slammed 1.3→1 in 0.13 s, one keyword on #FFC21A with ink #0E0E0C text), bottom gradient under the caption, channel bug + source tag top left, lower third = yellow bar + dark panel, lit 3-panel grid, transition whitelist, the news grade contrast(1.07) saturate(0.92) brightness(0.98) + 6 % warm soft light; vertical rule: caption stacked on two lines in the lower band, bug in the top safe area

density: The caption is always the lead (every spoken word is captioned). One package graphic (grid / lower third / slam card) per 8–12 s at most; a push-in or punch is the only thing between them. 40–60 % of the runtime is face + caption only.
not: not a TV news package (no anchor desk, no ticker, no crawl, no studio)
not Hormozi/CapCut captions: no thick black stroke, no all-caps word-by-word colour swaps, no bounce
not a keynote: no centred title-and-bullets, no page turns, no dissolves, no 3D flips
no second accent hue for decoration: red only for the bad number / loss
